```{r setup}
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(pheatmap)
library(tidyverse)
library(eulerr)
```

```{r data and helpers}
source("scripts/main-data.R")
source("scripts/helpers.R")

# a prism-like ggplot2 theme

theme_prismLike = theme_bw() +
  theme(
    aspect.ratio = 1,
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    strip.placement = "outside",
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.length = unit(-0.15, "cm"),
    axis.text.y.right = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.3),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.6)
  )
```

### Fig 8A: volcano

```{r volcano plots for each condition, fig.height=8, fig.width=3, dpi=600}
df = dea %>%
  mutate(group = factor(group, levels = unique(group))) %>%
  mutate(logFDR = -log10(FDR)) %>%
  mutate(logFDR = if_else(is.infinite(logFDR), 325, logFDR))

ggplot(
  df,
  aes(x = log2fold, y = logFDR)
) +
  facet_wrap(
    ~group, 
    ncol = 2,
    axes = "all",
    labeller = labeller(
      group = c(
        "WT_naive" = "wt",
        "sham_naive" = "sham",
        "TAK1KO_naive" = "KO",
        "TAK1KO_lipid" = "KO+lipid",
        "TAK1KO_TAK1-smRNA" = "KO+nat",
        "TAK1KO_mTAK1-smRNA" = "KO+D175A"
      )
    )
  ) +
  geom_point(
    aes(fill = sig),
    size = 0.8,
    shape = 21,
    color = "black",
    stroke = 0.25
  ) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed", lwd = 0.25) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-1, 1), linetype = "dashed", lwd = 0.25) +
  theme_prismLike +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("up" = "firebrick1", "ns" = "grey", "dn" = "steelblue1")
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.15, 0.25)),
    limits = c(0, 350),
    breaks = c(0, 100, 200, 300),
    sec.axis = dup_axis()
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    expand = expansion(mult = 0.2),
    breaks = c(-5, 0, 5, 10)
  ) +
  labs(x = "log2fold", y = "-log10(FDR)")

ggsave("volcano.png", h = 8, w = 3, dpi = 600)

df %>%
  select(group, sig) %>%
  count(group, sig)
```


### Fig 8B: heatmap

```{r heatmap of 1304 il1b reg genes, fig.height=7, fig.width=5}
goi_up = dea %>%
  filter(
    FDR <= 0.05,
    log2fold >= 1
  ) %>%
  pull(Gene) %>%
  unique()

up_mat = mat[goi_up, ]

goi_dn = dea %>%
  filter(
    FDR <= 0.05,
    log2fold <=-1
  ) %>%
  pull(Gene) %>%
  unique()

dn_mat = mat[goi_dn, ]

colsplits = factor(
  c(
    rep("WT", 4),
    rep("sham", 4),
    rep("TAK1KO", 4),
    rep("KO + lipid", 4),
    rep("rescue", 4),
    rep("mutant rescue", 4)
  ),
  levels = c(
    "WT",
    "sham",
    "TAK1KO",
    "KO + lipid",
    "rescue",
    "mutant rescue"
  )
)

# symmetric colorscale, 99.5% clipping

colors = generic_l2f_heatmap_colors(
  c(up_mat, dn_mat),
  scaleType = "symmetric",
  clipFactor = 0.995
)

up_hm = Heatmap(
  up_mat,
  col = colors,
  name = "log2fold",
  column_split = colsplits,
  cluster_columns = F,
  show_row_names = F,
  show_column_names = F,
  column_title_rot = 45,
  show_row_dend = F,
  use_raster = T,
  row_title = "936 upreg",
  border = "black",
  clustering_method_rows = "complete"
)

dn_hm = Heatmap(
  dn_mat,
  col = colors,
  name = "log2fold",
  column_split = colsplits,
  cluster_columns = F,
  show_row_names = F,
  show_column_names = F,
  column_title_rot = 45,
  show_row_dend = F,
  use_raster = T,
  row_title = "368 downreg",
  border = "black",
  clustering_method_rows = "complete"
)

# pdf("heatmap of 1304 il1b-reg DEGs.pdf", width = 5, height = 7)

png(
  "heatmap of 1304 il1b-reg DEGs.png", 
  width = 5, height = 6, units = "in", res = 600
)

up_hm %v% dn_hm

dev.off()

# save heatmaps

saveRDS(draw(up_hm), "data/heatmap_up_936.rds")
saveRDS(draw(dn_hm), "data/heatmap_dn_368.rds")

cleanup_objects()
```

```{r DEG count of 1304 il1b reg genes, fig.height=2, fig.width=6}

df = dea %>%
  filter(sig != "ns") %>%
  select(Gene, group, sig) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  count(group, sig) %>%
  mutate(
    label = n,
    n = if_else(sig == "dn", -n, n),
    text_offset = if_else(sig == "dn", 1.3, -0.3)
  )

ggplot(
  df,
  aes(x = group, y = n, fill = sig)
) +
  geom_col(color = "black", lwd = 0.3) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, lwd = 0.3) +
  geom_text(aes(label = label, vjust = text_offset)) +
  theme_prismLike +
  theme(
    aspect.ratio = 0.5
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    expand = expansion(mult = 0.3),
    breaks = c(-400, 0, 400, 800),
    labels = c(-400, 0, 400, 800),
    sec.axis = dup_axis()
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(
    labels = c("wt", "sham", "KO", "KO+lipid", "nat", "D175A"),
    expand = expansion(mult = 0.15)
  ) +
  labs(y = "DEG count", x = NULL, fill = NULL) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("steelblue2", "firebrick2")
  )

ggsave("counts of 1304 il1b-reg DEGs.png", h = 1.5, w = 6, dpi = 600)

cleanup_objects()
```

```{r pull stats for violin plots}

wt_up_738 = dea %>% 
  filter(condition == "WT", sig == "up") %>% 
  pull(Gene)

wt_dn_258 = dea %>% 
  filter(condition %in% c("WT"), sig == "dn") %>% 
  pull(Gene)

levels = c("wt", "sham", "ko", "lipid", "nat", "D175A")


violin_stats = list()

for(nm in list("wt_up_738", "wt_dn_258")){
  
  genes = get(nm)
  
  # get dataframe for genes
  df = tpm %>%
    filter(Gene %in% genes, treatment == "IL1B") %>%
    select(Gene, group, log2fold) %>%
    group_by(Gene, group) %>%
    summarize(log2fold = mean(log2fold), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(
      group = case_when(
        group == "WT_naive" ~ "wt",
        group == "sham_naive" ~ "sham",
        group == "TAK1KO_naive" ~ "ko",
        group == "TAK1KO_lipid" ~ "lipid",
        group == "TAK1KO_TAK1-smRNA" ~ "nat",
        group == "TAK1KO_mTAK1-smRNA" ~ "D175A"
      )
    ) %>%
    mutate(group = factor(group, levels = levels)) %>%
    arrange(Gene, group)
  
  # mean log2fold, median log2fold, and any other stats
  summary = df %>%
    group_by(group) %>%
    summarize(
      median = median(log2fold), 
      mean = mean(log2fold),
      .groups = "drop"
      )
  
  # run tukey's
  tukey = aov(log2fold~group, df) %>%
    TukeyHSD() %>%
    .$group %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    rownames_to_column("comparison")
  
  # pull p-value matrix
  pairwise_p = tukey %>%
    separate(comparison, c("x", "y"), sep = "-") %>%
    select(x, y, p = `p adj`) %>%
    bind_rows(
      tibble(
        x = c("wt", "sham", "ko", "lipid", "nat", "D175A"),
        y = c("wt", "sham", "ko", "lipid", "nat", "D175A"),
        p = 1
      )
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      x = factor(x, levels = levels),
      y = factor(y, levels = levels)
    ) %>%
    arrange(x, y) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = "y", values_from = "p") %>%
    column_to_rownames("x") %>%
    t() %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    rownames_to_column("x")
  
  # pull mean diff matrix
  pairwise_meandiff = tukey %>%
    separate(comparison, c("x", "y"), sep = "-") %>%
    select(x, y, mean_diff = diff) %>%
    bind_rows(
      tibble(
        x = c("wt", "sham", "ko", "lipid", "nat", "D175A"),
        y = c("wt", "sham", "ko", "lipid", "nat", "D175A"),
        mean_diff = 0
      )
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      x = factor(x, levels = levels),
      y = factor(y, levels = levels)
    ) %>%
    arrange(x, y) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = "y", values_from = "mean_diff") %>%
    column_to_rownames("x") %>%
    t() %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    rownames_to_column("x")
  
  # pull median diff matrix
  
  medianDiffs = combn(levels, 2, simplify = FALSE) %>%
    map_dfr(\(p) tibble(x = p[1], y = p[2])) %>%
    bind_rows(tibble(x = levels, y = levels)) %>%
    left_join(
      summary %>% select(x = group, x_med = median),
      by = "x"
    ) %>%
    left_join(
      summary %>% select(y = group, y_med = median),
      by = "y"
    ) %>%
    mutate(median_diff = y_med - x_med) %>%
    select(x, y, median_diff)
  
  
  pairwise_mediandiff = medianDiffs %>%
    mutate(
      x = factor(x, levels = levels),
      y = factor(y, levels = levels)
    ) %>% 
    arrange(x, y) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = "y", values_from = "median_diff")
  
  out = setNames(
    list(
      pairwise_p, 
      pairwise_meandiff, 
      pairwise_mediandiff,
      tukey,
      medianDiffs,
      summary
      ),
    paste0(nm, c(
      "_p", 
      "_meanDiff", 
      "_medianDiff", 
      "raw-tukey", 
      "raw-medianDiff",
      "summary"
      ))
  )
  
  violin_stats = c(violin_stats, out)
  
  
}

writexl::write_xlsx(violin_stats, "violin_stats.xlsx")

cleanup_objects()
```



### Fig 8F and 8G: closer look at 68 TAK1-upreg genes

```{r percent wt heatmap for all 68 genes}
# pull the 68

wt_up_738 = dea %>% 
  filter(condition == "WT", sig == "up") %>% 
  pull(Gene)

ko_up_71 = dea %>% 
  filter(condition == "TAK1KO", rescue == "naive", sig == "up") %>% 
  pull(Gene)

goi_68 = intersect(wt_up_738, ko_up_71)

pct_wt = tpm %>%
  filter(Gene %in% goi_68) %>%
  
  select(Gene, group, treatment, fold) %>%             # get linear fold
  
  group_by(Gene, group, treatment) %>%
  summarize(fold = mean(fold), .groups = "drop") %>%   # take average fold
  
  group_by(Gene, group) %>%
  reframe(fold = fold - fold[treatment == "NS"]) %>%
  filter(fold != 0) %>%                                # subtract baseline
  
  group_by(Gene) %>%
  mutate(pct_wt = fold / fold[group == "WT_naive"]) %>%
  ungroup() %>%                                        # calculate % WT
  
  group_by(Gene) %>%
  mutate(ranking_metric = mean(
    pct_wt[group %in% c("TAK1KO_naive", "TAK1KO_lipid")],
    na.rm = TRUE
  )) %>%                             # rank by effect (mean of KO & lipid)
  arrange(desc(ranking_metric)) %>%
  ungroup()

goi_68_ranked = unique(pct_wt$Gene)

pct_wt_mat = pct_wt %>%
  select(Gene, group, pct_wt) %>%
  mutate(
      group = case_when(
        group == "WT_naive" ~ "wt",
        group == "sham_naive" ~ "sham",
        group == "TAK1KO_naive" ~ "ko",
        group == "TAK1KO_lipid" ~ "lipid",
        group == "TAK1KO_TAK1-smRNA" ~ "nat",
        group == "TAK1KO_mTAK1-smRNA" ~ "D175A"
      )
    ) %>%
    mutate(group = factor(
      group, 
      levels = c("wt", "sham", "ko", "lipid", "nat", "D175A")
      )) %>%
  arrange(group) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = "group", values_from = "pct_wt") %>%
  column_to_rownames("Gene") %>%
  as.matrix()

hm = Heatmap(
  pct_wt_mat,
  cluster_rows = F,
  cluster_columns = F,
  col = generic_l2f_heatmap_colors(
    c(0, 1, 1.5), 
    scaleType = "one-sided",
    colorscale = c("white", "firebrick2", "firebrick4"),
    clipFactor = 1
    ),
  row_names_side = "left",
  name = "% WT"
)

png("supplemental_68_percentWT.png", h = 12, w = 5, res = 600, units = "in")
draw(hm)
dev.off()

write_rds(goi_68_ranked, "data/goi_68_ranked.rds")

cleanup_objects()
```

```{r plots for example genes, fig.height=2, fig.width=4}
goi = c("CXCL5", "ZC3H12A", "RELB", "CXCL1", "STAT5A", "TNFAIP3")

ylims = c(0, 13)

for(gene in goi){
  df = tpm %>%
    filter(Gene == gene) %>%
    mutate(
      group = case_when(
        group == "WT_naive" ~ "wt",
        group == "sham_naive" ~ "sham",
        group == "TAK1KO_naive" ~ "ko",
        group == "TAK1KO_lipid" ~ "lipid",
        group == "TAK1KO_TAK1-smRNA" ~ "nat",
        group == "TAK1KO_mTAK1-smRNA" ~ "mut"
      )
    ) %>%
    mutate(group = factor(
      group, 
      levels = c("wt", "sham", "ko", "lipid", "nat", "mut"))
    )
  
  ggplot(
    df,
    aes(x = group, y = log2tpm, fill = treatment, group = treatment)
  ) +
    stat_summary(
      geom = "errorbar",
      fun.data = "mean_sdl",
      fun.args = list(mult = 1),
      position = position_dodge(width = 0.75),
      width = 0.5,
      lwd = 0.2
    ) +
    stat_summary(
      geom = "col", 
      fun = "mean",
      position = position_dodge(width = 0.75),
      width = 0.75,
      color = "black",
      lwd = 0.2
    ) +
    geom_point(
      shape = 21,
      fill = "white",
      color = "black",
      position = position_dodge(width = 0.75),
      stroke = 0.2,
      size = 0.8
    ) +
    theme_prismLike +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      aspect.ratio = 0.8
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      sec.axis = dup_axis(),
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0.005, 0.25)),
      breaks = scales::breaks_pretty(n=3)
    ) +
    scale_x_discrete(
      expand = expansion(mult = 0.15)
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = ylims) +
    labs(x = NULL, title = gene)
  
  ggsave(paste0(gene, ".png"), h = 1.5, w = 3, dpi = 600)
}
```

### Supplemental fig 13: PCA

```{r pca on tpms}

# wt_up_738
goi = dea %>%
  filter(
    # group == "WT_naive",
    # sig == "up"
    FDR <= 0.05,
    abs(log2fold) >= 1
  ) %>%
  pull(Gene) %>%
  unique()

# build matrix
pc_mat <- tpm %>%
  filter(
    Gene %in% goi,
    treatment %in% c("NS", "IL1B")
  ) %>%
  mutate(sample = paste0(condition, "_", rescue, "_", treatment, "_", rep)) %>%
  select(Gene, sample, log2tpm) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = sample, values_from = log2tpm) %>%
  column_to_rownames("Gene") %>%
  as.matrix()

# PCA
pca <- prcomp(t(pc_mat), center = TRUE, scale. = FALSE)

# PCA values dataframe
pc_df <- as.data.frame(pca$x) %>%
  rownames_to_column("sample") %>%
  separate(
    sample, 
    into = c("condition","rescue","treatment", "rep"), 
    sep = "_",
    remove = F
  ) %>%
  mutate(sample2 = paste0(condition, "_", rescue, "_", rep)) %>%
  mutate(
    treatment = factor(treatment, levels = c("NS", "IL1B")),
    condition = factor(condition, levels = c("WT", "sham", "TAK1KO"))
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    id = case_when(
      str_detect(sample, "WT_naive") ~ "wt",
      str_detect(sample, "sham_naive") ~ "sham",
      str_detect(sample, "TAK1KO_naive") ~ "KO",
      str_detect(sample, "TAK1KO_lipid") ~ "lipid",
      str_detect(sample, "TAK1KO_TAK1-smRNA") ~ "nat",
      str_detect(sample, "TAK1KO_mTAK1-smRNA") ~ "D175A" 
    ),
    id = factor(id, levels = unique(id)),
    .before = 1
  )

# variation explained by each pc
pca_var <- (pca$sdev^2 / sum(pca$sdev^2)) * 100
pca_var <- pca_var %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  setNames("variance_explained") %>%
  mutate(
    PC = paste0("PC", row_number()),
    cumulative_variance = cumsum(variance_explained)
  ) %>%
  select(PC, variance_explained, cumulative_variance)

# across-replicate centroids
pc_centroids <- pc_df %>%
  group_by(condition, rescue, treatment) %>%
  summarise(across(starts_with("PC"), mean), .groups = "drop")

# per-replicate distances from NS
pc_distance <- pc_df %>%
  select(condition, rescue, treatment, rep, PC1, PC2) %>%
  left_join(
    pc_df %>%
      filter(treatment == "NS") %>%
      select(condition, rescue, rep, PC1, PC2) %>%
      rename(PC1_NS = PC1, PC2_NS = PC2),
    by = c("condition", "rescue", "rep")
  ) %>%
  filter(treatment != "NS") %>%
  mutate(
    dist = sqrt(
      (PC1 - PC1_NS)^2 + (PC2 - PC2_NS)^2
    )
  ) %>%
  select(condition, rescue, treatment, rep, dist) %>%
  mutate(
    group = paste0(condition, "_", rescue),
    group = factor(group, levels = unique(group))
  )

# per-replicate distance, Tukey's HSD
tukey = pc_distance %>%
  select(group, dist) %>%
  aov(dist ~ group, data = .) %>%
  TukeyHSD() %>%
  .$group %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("comparison") %>%
  select(comparison, diff ,pval = `p adj`) %>%
  mutate(
    sig = case_when(
      pval <= 0.001  ~ "***",
      pval <= 0.01   ~ "**",
      pval <= 0.05   ~ "*",
      TRUE           ~ "ns"
    )
  )

# PCA loadings for each gene
pca_loadings <- as.data.frame(pca$rotation) %>%
  rownames_to_column("Gene") %>%
  select(Gene, PC1, PC2) %>%
  mutate(
    PC1_contribution = PC1^2 / sum(PC1^2) * 100,
    PC2_contribution = PC2^2 / sum(PC2^2) * 100
  )

# cleanup_objects()
```

```{r what drives the upward shift along pc2?}

# get rescue-unique 118 genes
unique_to_rescue = setdiff(
  dea %>% filter(group == "TAK1KO_TAK1-smRNA", sig == "up") %>% pull(Gene),
  dea %>% filter(group == "WT_naive", sig == "up") %>% pull(Gene)
)


# rank pc2 loadings and check if in 118
df_rescue <- pca_loadings %>%
  select(Gene, PC2) %>%
  arrange(desc(PC2)) %>%
  mutate(
    rank = row_number(),
    in_set = Gene %in% unique_to_rescue
  )

# pull loadings for later
unq_rescue_loadings = df_rescue %>% filter(in_set) %>% pull(PC2)

# plot ranks
barplot(deframe(select(df_rescue, PC2)))

# plot hits
ggplot(filter(df_rescue, in_set), aes(x = rank)) +
  geom_segment(
    aes(xend = rank, y = 0, yend = 1),
    color = "firebrick2",
    linewidth = 0.4
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(1, max(df_rescue$rank)))

# plot density

ggplot(df_rescue, aes(x = PC2, fill = in_set)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.4) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("FALSE" = "grey30", "TRUE" = "firebrick1"),
    labels = c("other DEGs", "118 rescue-unique DEGs")
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "PC2 loading",
    y = "density",
    fill = NULL
  )




# repeat for a similarly-sized group, sham-unique 106 genes

unique_to_sham = setdiff(
  dea %>% filter(group == "sham_naive", sig == "up") %>% pull(Gene),
  dea %>% filter(group == "WT_naive", sig == "up") %>% pull(Gene)
)

# rank pc2 loadings and check if in 106
df_sham <- pca_loadings %>%
  select(Gene, PC2) %>%
  arrange(desc(PC2)) %>%
  mutate(
    rank = row_number(),
    in_set = Gene %in% unique_to_sham
  )

# pull loadings for later
unq_sham_loadings = df_sham %>% filter(in_set) %>% pull(PC2)

# plot density

ggplot(df_sham, aes(x = PC2, fill = in_set)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.4) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("FALSE" = "grey30", "TRUE" = "firebrick1"),
    labels = c("other DEGs", "106 sham-unique DEGs")
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "PC2 loading",
    y = "density",
    fill = NULL
  )

# rescue-unique vs all other PCA genes
wilcox.test(
  unq_rescue_loadings,
  pca_loadings %>%
    filter(!Gene %in% unique_to_rescue) %>%
    pull(PC2)
)

# sham-unique vs all other PCA genes
wilcox.test(
  unq_sham_loadings,
  pca_loadings %>%
    filter(!Gene %in% unique_to_sham) %>%
    pull(PC2)
)

# rescue-unique vs sham-unique
wilcox.test(
  unq_rescue_loadings,
  unq_sham_loadings
)
```

### Supplemental fig ???: additional metrics for 68 TAK1KO-upreg genes

```{r}

# ===== main data =====

goi_68_ranked = readRDS("data/goi_68_ranked.rds")

ko_vs_wt_diff = read_tsv("data/KO_IL1B_interaction_test.txt")

mat_log2fold_average = tpm %>%
  filter(Gene %in% goi_68_ranked, treatment == "IL1B") %>%
  select(Gene, group, log2fold) %>%
  group_by(Gene, group) %>%
  summarize(log2fold = mean(log2fold), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(
    group = case_when(
      group == "WT_naive" ~ "wt",
      group == "sham_naive" ~ "sham",
      group == "TAK1KO_naive" ~ "ko",
      group == "TAK1KO_lipid" ~ "lipid",
      group == "TAK1KO_TAK1-smRNA" ~ "nat",
      group == "TAK1KO_mTAK1-smRNA" ~ "D175A"
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(group = factor(
    group, 
    levels = c("wt", "sham", "ko", "lipid", "nat", "D175A")
  )) %>%
  arrange(Gene, group) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = "group", values_from = "log2fold") %>%
  column_to_rownames("Gene") %>%
  as.matrix() %>%
  .[goi_68_ranked, ]

mat_tpm_average = tpm %>%
  filter(Gene %in% goi_68_ranked) %>%
  select(Gene, group, treatment, log2tpm) %>%
  group_by(Gene, group, treatment) %>%
  summarize(log2tpm = mean(log2tpm), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(
    group = case_when(
      group == "WT_naive" ~ "wt",
      group == "sham_naive" ~ "sham",
      group == "TAK1KO_naive" ~ "ko",
      group == "TAK1KO_lipid" ~ "lipid",
      group == "TAK1KO_TAK1-smRNA" ~ "nat",
      group == "TAK1KO_mTAK1-smRNA" ~ "D175A"
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(group = factor(
    group, 
    levels = c("wt", "sham", "ko", "lipid", "nat", "D175A")
  )) %>%
  arrange(Gene, group) %>%
  unite(name, c(group, treatment), sep = "_") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = "name", values_from = "log2tpm") %>%
  column_to_rownames("Gene") %>%
  as.matrix() %>%
  .[goi_68_ranked, ]

colsplits_tpm = factor(
  c(
    rep("wt", 2),
    rep("sham", 2),
    rep("ko", 2),
    rep("lipid", 2),
    rep("nat", 2),
    rep("D175A", 2)
  ),
  levels = c(
    "wt",
    "sham",
    "ko",
    "lipid",
    "nat",
    "D175A"
  )
)


# log2fold matrix

hm_l2f = Heatmap(
  mat_log2fold_average,
  cluster_rows = F,
  cluster_columns = F,
  col = generic_l2f_heatmap_colors(
    c(-10, 10),
    scaleType = "symmetric"
  ),
  name = "log2fold",
  row_names_side = "left"
)

png("supplemental_68_l2f.png", h = 12, w = 5, res = 600, units = "in")
draw(hm_l2f)
dev.off()



# log2tpm matrix

hm_tpm = Heatmap(
  mat_tpm_average,
  cluster_rows = F,
  cluster_columns = F,
  col = generic_l2f_heatmap_colors(
    mat_combined[goi_68_ranked, ],
    scaleType = "symmetric"
  ),
  name = "log2tpm",
  column_split = colsplits_tpm,
  row_names_side = "left",
)

png("supplemental_68_tpm.png", h = 12, w = 12, res = 600, units = "in")
draw(hm_tpm)
dev.off()



# interaction test diff matrix

diff_mat = ko_vs_wt_diff %>%
  column_to_rownames("Gene") %>%
  select(log2diff) %>%
  as.matrix() %>%
  .[goi_68_ranked, ]

hm_log2diff = Heatmap(
  diff_mat,
  cluster_rows = F,
  col = generic_l2f_heatmap_colors(
    diff_mat,
    scaleType = "symmetric",
    colorscale = c("aquamarine4", "aquamarine2", "white", "orchid2", "orchid4")
  ),
  name = "log2diff"
)

png("supplemental_68_log2diff.png", h = 12, w = 3, res = 600, units = "in")
draw(hm_log2diff)
dev.off()


# interaction test FDR matrix

fdr_mat = ko_vs_wt_diff %>%
  column_to_rownames("Gene") %>%
  select(FDR) %>%
  mutate(FDR = if_else(FDR <= 0.05, 1, 0)) %>%
  as.matrix() %>%
  .[goi_68_ranked, ]

hm_fdr = Heatmap(
  fdr_mat,
  cluster_rows = F,
  col = generic_l2f_heatmap_colors(
    diff_mat,
    scaleType = "one-sided",
    colorscale = c("white", "black")
  ),
  name = "log2diff"
)

png("supplemental_68_FDR.png", h = 12, w = 3, res = 600, units = "in")
draw(hm_fdr)
dev.off()
```
